desc:
In 2042, a mutated virus tore through Australia, turning the Outback into a lawless graveyard of the undead. With civilization in ruins and supplies running low, the only hope lies in a cure found deep beyond the horizon. Fuel up your truck, band together, and battle through the endless, zombie-infested roads on the road to salvation… or die trying.
